3.literal: then I'd be able to talk smoothly.

16.official: Ahh, yeah. I guess it is that time of year.

17.literal: Next time, go ask Santa for it.
17.official: You'll have to ask Santa for the next bottle.

19.literal: Ee hee hee, never thought I'd get booze handed to me for free!
19.official: Ee hee hee, didn't expect a free drink tonight!

20.literal: Life's not such a bad thing after all.
20.official: Life's just great, I tell ya.

21.official: Oh, and I'm a whisky hound, thanks.

24.literal: ...Does it really have to be potato?

27.official: You gotta expand your horizons! You'll never get a woman.

28.literal: Back when I was a salaryman...
28.official: When I was a young stud, I'd take gals out, get 'em wasted, and...

29.official: To extract from Kazama-san the information he possesses on the Empty Lot.

30.literal: That you would join hands with us
30.official: that you and I would join hands

31.literal: was the wish of none other than Kazama-san himself.

32.literal: The reason Kazama-san entrusted you to me

33.literal: was half a year ago, before that man went to prison.
33.official: It was half a year ago that Kazama-san entrusted you to my care. Before he departed for prison, of course.

34.literal: He had foreseen very nearly all of it.
34.official: Even then, he knew with considerable certainty that Kuze would set his sights on you, and that you would find yourself unable to remain in the family.

35.literal: His depth of character runs far too deep.
35.official: His abilities and wisdom cannot be overstated.

36.literal: His aim in obtaining it is, most likely, not merely to protect himself—

37.literal: he must be painting a bigger picture.
37.official: Knowing him, his designs are in service of something far greater.

38.literal: Do I have your understanding now, Kiryu-san?
38.official: Have I earned your understanding, Kiryu-san?

39.literal: Tachibana... that you would carry on the boss's will—
39.official: Tachibana... What proof have you got that you're the guy Kazama-san entrusted all this to?

40.literal: According to what Kazama-san told me,
40.official: Kazama-san led me to believe that this would serve as sufficient proof.

41.literal: I was merely holding onto it to hand over to you.
41.official: I merely took care of it until I could pass it on to you.

42.literal: I hadn't understood the first thing about what kind of man he was.
42.official: I guess... I still didn't have any clue just what kind of man Kazama-san really is.

43.literal: Ever since that day I defied the old man and became a yakuza...
43.official: That's something I decided the day I went against his wishes and joined the yakuza.

44.literal: That a young punk like this beat me one-on-one...
44.official: No fucking way... A total rookie, one-on-one, and he wins!?

46.literal: Yes! It's my... my loss, President!
46.official: Very! He's, well... He's got me beat, boss!

47.official: You signed off on Oda testing me like this?

48.literal: He's my irreplaceable right-hand man. That's why, before bringing you into our ranks,

49.literal: Is that so. ...I'm starting to feel like a complete idiot.
49.official: Is that so? ...I'm beginning to feel more and more like an idiot.

51.official: Did you have the guys downstairs attack me? Why?

52.literal: You were sizing us up too, weren't you?

53.literal: What could you possibly learn about me just by having your men attack me?
53.official: And you thought having your crew attack me would give you an answer?

55.official: I tell ya, it's tough not being able to delegate.

58.literal: In that case... neither of us needs to hold back, huh.
58.official: In that case, I guess neither of us needs to hold back.

59.official: It feels like this is the only sort of welcome I get, lately.

60.literal: I've really been made a fool of.

61.literal: The punk's lost his damn mind!
